correction: A lint tool counts as run by make ci only when a simple command that make ci reaches calls it, after the Makefile variables its commands use are expanded; a variable that make ci never uses, a message, a comment or an installer argument that names the tool does not count
evidence: Cross-review of frostyard/core#253 at 754e01f: makeTargetText added every variable assignment and every mention of a tool name to the text that stood for executed commands, so 'LINTER := golangci-lint' and 'echo "Install shellcheck"' gave false passes. Fixed in frostyard/core#253 (commandCalls, expandVariables) with targeted tests
